steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with the vendor bid already present.
Ensure counter offers are available on RFQ rounds.
Ensure the existing event uses the enabled eRFX flow.
Open the buyer comparison grid, where the catalog performs counter offers.
Send the expressible portion of the buyer’s counter offer on the vendor’s own bid.
Verify that the buyer grid marks the vendor bid as having a counter offer.
Have the invited vendor accept the pending counter offer in the supplier portal.
Verify on the buyer side that the vendor’s counter offer is marked accepted.
Return to the buyer’s Master QCS after acceptance.
Verify that the displayed line amounts and sum total are arithmetically consistent with the current prices.
